{{Quote|They're right on our tail, Boba, so where ''is'' it? Some stupid helmet and an empty case! ''Where's the Blade of Beginnings''?|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
The '''Blade of Beginnings''' was a mythical Mandalorian bladed weapon that was fitted with a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking shield]] that could be deactivated only through contact with [[moon dust]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a fake version of the blade was discovered on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Korasa]] and taken to a [[Jedi Research Facility|research facility]] in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to be studied by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], who incorrectly believed the blade to be genuine. Hoping to sell the weapon for thousands of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], two rival [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] [[Korasa job|raided]] Timira [[City/Legends|City]], hoping to steal the blade. The [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]] breached the research facility's vault and successfully escaped with the artifact, though in the aftermath of the mission they realized that the blade was fake and thus worthless.
